notes.text: In decimal estates a -U/-S suffix pair means unscaled value and scale (BigDecimal parts), not unsigned/signed; name them <noun>Unscaled and <noun>Scale and keep one noun for both.

When identical value groups (unscaled, scale, exponent) are merged into one generated type, name the type and its fields generically; a name taken from the first group (PaymentValue) mislabels the others.
A numeric rounding-mode code 0..6 that maps to UP, DOWN, CEILING, FLOOR, HALF_UP, HALF_DOWN, HALF_EVEN is Java RoundingMode order; the catch-all that throws when digits would be lost is UNNECESSARY.

Library scratch areas carry fields that are never referenced (spare registers, groups for unimplemented op codes); check references before naming and send such fields to review rather than inventing roles.
A paragraph name can disagree with the copybook about what a record is (CHECK-PERIOD validates the OFFER layout); prefer the layout and the callee's usage, and mark the conflict for review.
Reject texts and DISPLAY messages often name the record or count in plain words (CASE RECORD, RESULT RECORDS); quote them first when naming layouts and run totals.
